# Emma the Teachie

> > A comprehensive collection of no-prep, interactive biology resources designed to make teaching engaging and accessible for educators.

Emma the Teachie provides ready-to-use biology curriculum materials including doodle notes, interactive Google Slides lessons, and assessment tools. The site specializes in making complex biological concepts engaging through visual learning strategies and classroom-ready resources available on TeachersPayTeachers.
